test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 05 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

He will make mistakes, but he will learn / by making mistakes. So, dear parents, / once you put the money in your / children's little pockets, forget all on it.

options.text: children's little pockets, forget all on it
once you put the money in your
by making mistakes. So, dear parents,
He will make mistakes, but he will learn

solution:
The erroneous part is option 1) i.e. 'children's little pockets, forget all on it.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in the part 'children's little pockets, forget all on it.'
 
• According to the rules of preposition, **'on'** is used to denote when a thing is touching the surface of a place; to denote dates and days.
 
• Whereas, **'of'** is used to indicate relating to, belonging to; to indicate reference; to specify the number or an amount.
 
• In the given sentence, **'of'** is used to specify the amount of money.
 
• Therefore in the given sentence, we need to use 'of' in place of 'on' to make the sentence grammatically correct.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

 

Correct sentence:__* He will make mistakes, but he will learn by making mistakes. So, dear parents, once you put the money in your **children's little pockets, forget all of it.***
